facts.text: Report holder OK LAMINATORS, a subsidiary of Mercer International; evaluation subject is OK Laminators CLT.

CLT is for floor and roof components in Type I and II construction (IBC), and in roof and floor decks in Type III (interior floor decks only), IV and V; under the IRC an engineered design is required (IRC §R301.1.3).
Use is limited to dry service, with lumber moisture content below 16 percent.

Connectors, connections, and cutting, drilling and notching of floor and roof-deck panels have not been evaluated; diaphragm design is out of scope and needs complete detailing satisfactory to the code official.
Roof decks must be covered with approved roof coverings per IBC Chapter 15; special inspection per IBC Sections 1704 and 1705.
Panels are produced in 'Okanagan Falls, British Columbia, Canada' under ICC-ES inspections (facility statement).
Evidence listed: ICC-ES AC455, dated May 2018.
